changes.comment: BREAKING: Rebuild: stop the daemon, delete `~/.dreamux/state/<dispatcher-id>/` for every dispatcher, remove any `dispatchers[].channels[].collaborationSpace` key from `config.json`, start the daemon, and recreate Teams and bindings. Persisted agent identities lose the `role`, `session_id`, and `transcript_locator` fields in favour of one provider-owned `session` object, and a record still carrying a removed field fails loud; Core no longer owns `channel-bindings.json`, the Collaboration Space store, or its config key, so existing routes are not migrated. The Team record replaces the persisted dissolve state machine with its status plus `worktree.cleanup_state`, and Team name claims and the create-request ledger are gone. The Agent MCP surface changes with it: Team `bind_channel`/`transfer_back` and the Core collaboration-space tools are removed (routing is now the Channel's own tool), `dissolve` answers with a submitted receipt instead of blocking, and `last` returns recent Activity Records (`limit` 1-200) instead of completed transcript turns and no longer reports `transcript_path`. Scheduled cron fires submit immediately through ordinary admission and may fold into a running turn.
